**Link type:** shared pathway (Reactome:R-HSA-8876198)

**Proposed mechanism:** TRAPPC12 (HGNC:21598) —DISRUPTS→ TRAPP complex assembly and function (GO:0031573); TRAPP complex assembly and function (GO:0031573) —LEADS_TO→ Intellectual disability (HP:0001249); TRAPP complex assembly and function (GO:0031573) —LEADS_TO→ Hearing impairment (HP:0000365); TRAPP complex assembly and function (GO:0031573) —LEADS_TO→ Pontine hypoplasia (HP:0007301); TRAPP complex assembly and function (GO:0031573) —LEADS_TO→ Brain atrophy (HP:0002120). **How to falsify it:** The hypothesis would be falsified if pathogenic variants in TRAPPC12 were found to be extremely rare (<0.01% frequency) in large population databases like gnomAD for either disease, or if distinct, non-overlapping sets of genes were identified as causal for each disease. _(variant: rs758601674)_

**Why it matters:** Understanding the shared role of the TRAPP complex in these distinct neurological disorders could lead to therapeutic strategies targeting intracellular trafficking pathways, potentially benefiting patients with either condition.
